class.name: PhysXLensFlare3D
class.brief_description: A camera lens flare from the frame's bright light, provided by the PhysX module.
class.description: The light a real lens reflects between its glass elements: every bright part of the frame (the sun, fire, headlights, [PhysXFlow3D] flames) is copied back over the screen as a row of soft, tinted ghosts along the line through the screen's centre, plus a faint halo ring. The flare follows the light as it moves on screen and fades as the light leaves the frame or is covered. It is image-based: no light needs to be tagged, and it works the same for every bright light. How it looks is a [PhysXLensFlareSettings] resource in [member settings]: save one with the Inspector to reuse a look across scenes. Without one the node draws [PhysXLensFlareSettings]'s defaults (a warm eight-ghost flare). The flare is drawn after [PhysXLightShafts3D] and before [PhysXLensDirt3D], so a lens with dirt on it lights up under the flare too. Works with the Forward+ and Mobile renderers, not Compatibility (which has no compositor effects). Only one [PhysXLensFlare3D] is drawn per frame; with several, which one is unspecified.

members.member: How the flare looks. Edits to it show the next frame. When [code]null[/code], the default look is drawn.
